licenses.text:
George Noyes Bible, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/engnoy/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/engnoy/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible, translated into English by George Noyes (1869)
> Public Domain
> Language: English
> Dialect: archaic British
> Translation by: George Noyes
> 2019-10-24

Why this is public domain:
Translator: George Rapall Noyes, 1798-1868, United States. Text: Job (1827), Psalms (1827), the Prophets (1843), Proverbs, Ecclesiastes and Song of Songs (1846), and the New Testament (Boston, American Unitarian Association, 1869). No other editor is named. US origin: published before 1931.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=engnoy), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/engnoy/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_R._Noyes; https://archive.org/details/newtestament00noye; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
